scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:gh: npm run build && npx gh-pages -d dist
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
